## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a robust, automated cross‑region DR solution for SAP on AWS with concrete RPO/RTO targets, DNS failover, and immutable backups.

## Key Concepts

- SAP HANA System Replication (ASYNC) across regions
- Route 53 failover routing and health checks
- Immutable backups in S3 (Object Lock) and cross-region retention
- CloudFormation/IaC for cross-region roles and DNS records
- Cutover automation and rollback considerations

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  CrossRegionDRRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAPCrossRegionDRRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
```

```yaml
DRRecordPrimary:
  Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
  Properties:
    HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
    Name: sap-hana.example.com
    Type: A
    SetIdentifier: Primary
    Failover: PRIMARY
    TTL: 60
    ResourceRecords:
      - !Ref PrimaryIP

DRRecordSecondary:
  Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
  Properties:
    HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
    Name: sap-hana.example.com
    Type: A
    SetIdentifier: Secondary
    Failover: SECONDARY
    TTL: 60
    ResourceRecords:
      - !Ref SecondaryIP
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question tests real-world DR design for SAP on AWS at scale, including cross-region replication, automated failover, and least-privilege controls. It probes integration points across SAP HANA, S3, IAM, and workflow services.

## Key Concepts
- SAP HANA System Replication (async vs sync) and log shipping
- Cross-region S3 backups with KMS-encrypted vaults
- IAM role design and SCPs for least privilege
- Step Functions with Lambda for automated DR workflow
- CloudFormation/IaC for DR artifacts

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation skeleton for DR roles and S3 backup configuration
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SAP HANA DR Roles and Infrastructure'

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Primary Region HANA to replicate data
  HANAReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sap-hana-dr-replication-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2RoleforSSM
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::dr-backup-primary-bucket/*'

  # IAM Role for DR Region Lambda functions
  DRLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sap-dr-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRWorkflowPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::dr-backup-primary-bucket'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::dr-backup-primary-bucket/*'

  # S3 Cross-Region Backup Bucket
  DRBackupBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: dr-backup-primary-bucket
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyId: alias/sap-dr-backup-key
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ArchiveAfter30Days
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: ''
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 30
              - StorageClass: DEEP_ARCHIVE
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  # Step Functions State Machine for DR Failover
  DRStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: sap-dr-failover-workflow
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          {
            "Comment": "SAP HANA DR Failover State Machine",
            "StartAt": "CheckPrimaryHealth",
            "States": {
              "CheckPrimaryHealth": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:check-hana-health",
                "Next": "IsPrimaryHealthy",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 60
              },
              "IsPrimaryHealthy": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.healthStatus",
                    "StringEquals": "healthy",
                    "Next": "WaitForRecovery"
                  }
                ],
                "Default": "InitiateFailover"
              },
              "WaitForRecovery": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 30,
                "Next": "CheckPrimaryHealth"
              },
              "InitiateFailover": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:initiate-hana-failover",
                "Next": "PromoteDRSite",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 300
              },
              "PromoteDRSite": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:promote-dr-site",
                "Next": "UpdateDNS",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 600
              },
              "UpdateDNS": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:update-route53-health",
                "Next": "VerifyApplication",
                "TimeoutSeconds": 120
              },
              "VerifyApplication": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:verify-app-connectivity",
                "End": true,
                "TimeoutSeconds": 180
              }
            }
          }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt DRLambdaRole.Arn

Outputs:
  ReplicationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the HANA replication role
    Value: !GetAtt HANAReplicationRole.Arn
  DRStateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the DR failover state machine
    Value: !GetAtt DRStateMachine.Arn
```

## Answer Framework
1. **Replication Architecture**: Use SAP HANA System Replication (HSR) in async mode for cross-region with continuous log shipping to achieve <5 min RPO
2. **Backup Strategy**: Continuous S3 cross-region replication with lifecycle policies to GLACIER/DEEP_ARCHIVE, encrypted with customer-managed KMS keys
3. **Failover Automation**: Step Functions state machine coordinates health checks, DNS failover, and DR site promotion
4. **Security**: Dedicated IAM roles with least-privilege policies; SCPs restrict cross-region access and enforce encryption requirements

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question tests the ability to design a production-grade, cross-region disaster recovery solution for SAP HANA on EC2, balancing security (IAM roles, SCPs), connectivity (PrivateLink/VPC Endpoints), and operability (SSM orchestration, immutable backups) while meeting strict RPO and RTO requirements.

## Key Concepts

- **Cross-region DR design**: SAP HANA system replication for near-synchronous or asynchronous data replication between regions
- **IAM Roles with SCPs**: Cross-account trust relationships with least-privilege access controls
- **PrivateLink/VPC Endpoints**: Secure, private connectivity to SAP components without traversing the public internet
- **Cross-region backups**: Immutable S3 backups with lifecycle policies across regions
- **IaC reproducibility**: Infrastructure as Code templates for automated trust relationships and endpoint provisioning

## Code Example

```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation snippet (illustrative)
Resources:
  # Cross-region trust role in DR account
  DRTrustRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: cross-region-dr-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::${PrimaryAccountId}:root
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:RequestedRegion: ["${DRRegion}"]
  # SAP Endpoint Service in DR region
  SAPEndpointService:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpointService
    Properties:
      AcceptanceRequired: true
      NetworkLoadBalancerArns:
        - !GetAtt SAPNLB.Arn
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical automation skills for SAP HANA backup reliability, emphasizing serverless event-driven verification, durable state management, and timely alerting mechanisms.

## Key Concepts
- S3 versioning with encrypted backup storage
- Lambda event-driven processing on S3 PUT operations
- Backup integrity verification using cryptographic checksums
- Durable result storage via DynamoDB
- Automated alerting through SNS or CloudWatch

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode: verify backup integrity
function verifyBackup(backupKey) {
  const actual = computeChecksum(backupData);
  const expected = getExpectedChecksum(backupKey);
  
  const result = {
    backupKey,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: actual === expected ? 'verified' : 'failed',
    actualChecksum: actual,
    expectedChecksum: expected
  };
  
  // Record in DynamoDB for durability
  dynamoDB.put(result);
  
  // Alert on failures
  if (result.status === 'failed') {
    sns.publish({
      message: `Backup integrity check failed for ${backupKey}`,
      subject: 'SAP HANA Backup Alert'
    });
  }
  
  return result;
}
```

## CloudFormation Example
```yaml
Resources:
  BackupVerificationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAP-HANA-BackupVerificationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/backup-verification-results
        - PolicyName: SNSAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: arn:aws:sns:*:*:backup-alerts
```

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect low-downtime SAP DR using AWS-native services, with SAP authorization mapping and cross-region security.

## Key Concepts
- SAP HANA System Replication across regions
- Route 53 failover and health checks
- Cross-account IAM trust and SCPs
- STS-based JIT MFA elevation
- Cross-region backups with KMS encryption
- PrivateLink for SAP components
- EventBridge automation and CloudWatch observability
- Minimal IaC for cross-region trust roles

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal cross-region trust role
Resources:
  CrossRegionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_A:root
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DRAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to architect cross-region data residency, masking, and auditability in SAP on AWS, plus concrete IaC for cross-region keys and logging.

## Key Concepts

- Cross-region AWS KMS and CMKs
- Data masking in SAP/HANA proxies
- Centralized immutable audit logs (S3 Object Lock)
- IAM SCPs and least privilege
- S3 bucket replication and DR coordination

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SapAuditBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: sap-audit-logging
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 3650
  CrossRegionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Cross-region key for masking/audit
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy: { ... }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test DR failover for the masking/audit pipeline?
- What metrics alerting would you add for masking failures?
